description: The file contains unit tests for the class 'ThingAcknowledgementFactory' within the Eclipse Ditto project, specifically testing creation and parsing of acknowledgements related to 'things'.

classes.name: ThingAcknowledgementFactoryTest
classes.description: Unit test class for 'ThingAcknowledgementFactory', testing creation and JSON parsing of acknowledgements.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes 'dittoHeaders' with a new builder, setting correlation ID and response requirement.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that the 'ThingAcknowledgementFactory' class is immutable.

methods.name: newAcknowledgementReturnsExpected
methods.description: Tests that creating a new acknowledgement via the factory produces an object with expected field values.

methods.name: fromJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Tests that an acknowledgement serialized to JSON and then parsed back yields an equivalent object.
